rows.label: Up to the threshold (skiktgräns)
rows.basis: Taxable earned income (beskattningsbar förvärvsinkomst), per year
rows.note: Municipal income tax (on average 32.38%) is due on all taxable earned income; state tax comes on top above the threshold. With the basic allowance the state tax starts at an income of SEK 660,400 (under 66) or SEK 760,500 (66 or older at the start of the year).
